mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals an easing monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of months where FEDFUNDS declines by at least 0.25 percentage points from the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate exceeding 5.0% signals a tightening monetary policy that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS exceeds 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the unemployment rate below 4.5% and a month-over-month increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) above 0.5% signals a strong labor market and robust consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE < 4.5% and RSAFS (mo/mo) > 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: In the late-cycle expansion phase of the business cycle, a decline in monthly housing starts (HOUST) below the 3-month moving average signals a weakening housing market, which typically precedes a correction in equity markets, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances during late-cycle expansion when HOUST declines below its 3-month moving average.

mechanism_narrative: A month-over-month increase in payroll employment (PAYEMS) above 0.5% signals a strengthening labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of months where PAYEMS increases by at least 0.5% month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly housing starts (HOUST) level below 1800 thousand units signals a contraction in the housing sector, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where HOUST < 1800.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous month-over-month decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and a year-over-year increase in the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) above 2.5% signals a stagflationary environment, which typically causes equity market sell-offs, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO (mo/mo) < 0% and CPIAUCSL (y/y) > 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: During a supply-driven expansion phase (indicated by INDPRO above 105), a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 105 signals a contraction in manufacturing activity, which typically precedes equity market weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances during supply-driven expansion when INDPRO declines below 105.
